network: loopback; delay is added per application POST before sending

conditions.baseline: pre-change UI artifact; application JSON gzip disabled
conditions.candidate: current source UI and host; negotiated gzip enabled
conditions.cold: new browser context for each phase/engine/delay
conditions.delay: extra delay per application POST, not a full WAN bandwidth simulation
conditions.webkit_reload_note: Network cancellation page errors were observed during reload in both baseline and candidate; retained in samples. Cold samples have no page errors.
